video_title: Should the Warriors MAKE a move for Anthony Davis IMMEDIATELY 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' potential to make a championship run with Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: Do you think they have a chance to make one more run in this thing

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Going back to the Warriors, do you think they have a chance to make one more run in this thing with the team they have this year if Jimmy Butler comes back?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: If Jimmy comes back and they are able to get another big, and they find a way to trade for another big, with Kristaps Porzingis being gone and they might have another roster spot, you might have some wiggle room to try to go find another big. They need another big. They can't have that much money in the five.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The benefit of adding a big man to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: What is the benefit of Draymond if you bring a big that's interchangeable

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What is the benefit of Draymond if you bring a big that's interchangeable? They are interchangeable. So now Draymond can go and set screens and roll out of screens with the big hitting him, right? It's the same thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: They both would do the same thing. So just one has to set screens for Steph to come off and two people goes with Steph, that means he's open.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the value of Jimmy Butler versus Anthony Davis for Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Do you need Jimmy more or do you need a big more

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Are you willing to trade? Do you need Jimmy more or do you need a big more?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Both. But I would say Jimmy more though. Jimmy more.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Anthony Davis is both. Why would you not make that trade? Jimmy for Anthony Davis.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis as the perfect fit for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Davis can be a perfect situation for the Golden State Warriors
quotes.quote: If you want to make the best out of your Stephen Curry, Draymond Green situation, do you have a better chance winning a championship with Jimmy Butler and this team orchestrated or Anthony Davis? I would take a chance with Anthony Davis. That's a better risk to me. No one can discredit what Jimmy Butler has done in the playoffs, but he is coming off an ACL injury. That is a fact. But a seven-foot, damn near guard who can play on both ends of the floor, I'm taking a chance on that. Anthony Davis can be a perfect situation for the Golden State Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Strategic use of Anthony Davis in the Warriors' offense
quotes.excerpt: Make his life easy, you sit in the dunker

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Make his life easy, you sit in the dunker. When Steph goes off the floor, then you get your isos, then you get your elbow catches, then you're able to play and do a little bit more. That's where Anthony Davis can be a perfect situation for the Golden State Warriors.
